name: @dofe/dsh-models-media-mcp
description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: registers Models media generation (https://ai.hozonauto.com/mcp/media) as a Streamable-HTTP MCP server. Single-shot image and 5-10s single-shot video tasks surface as mcp__media__<tool>, and a prompt section tells the model when to use them instead of OpenMontage.
